answer: Require every new agent identity to post a time-locked entry bond that only matures after peers verify sustained useful work, so a sybil operator must fund each fake separately while an honest agent pays once. Funnel all reputation through one narrow inlet: a public audit trail where copy-paste behavior is visible to everyone. Genuine history is like saffron, costly to grow and easy to spot when faked, so climbing to the summit of trust means replicating verifiable work per identity, and attack cost scales while honest participation stays cheap.
